# FormFieldLib

`FormFieldLib` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `field:enable()`.

## Methods

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`enable()`](enable.md) | Enable / disable the field. | 1.1.0 |
| [`focus()`](focus.md) | Give the focus to the field. | 1.5.10 |
| [`rect()`](rect.md) | Get the field rect. | 1.5.14 |
